title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush
summary: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush is an upcoming 2026 racing game from the developers behind Hot Wheels Unleashed & Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged. title: HW Road Trippin' Series (2014)
summary: Hot Wheels Road Trippin’ is a 32–car series themed to notable driving roads. The series originally only included American roads but expanded in 2015 to be internationally themed.
